def stimulus(rng, cycles):

            data_in = 0

        elif i < 6:

            data_in = 0
            has_data_to_send = 0
        else:
            rst = 0
            phase = (i - 6) % 24
            if phase < 4:

                data_in = (i * 5 + 3) & 0xF
            elif phase < 8:

                data_in = rng.randrange(16)
            elif phase < 12:

                data_in = rng.randrange(16)
            elif phase < 16:
                has_data_to_send = 0
                data_in = 0
            elif phase < 20:

                data_in = (i ^ 0xA) & 0xF
            else:
                has_data_to_send = rng.randrange(2)
                data_in = rng.randrange(16)
        row = {
            "rst": rst & 0x1,
            "data_in": data_in & 0xF,
            "has_data_to_send": has_data_to_send & 0x1,
        }
        if i >= 6 and rng.random() < 0.3:

                "has_data_to_send": mid_send & 0x1,
            }
            data_in = mid_data
            has_data_to_send = mid_send
        rows.append(row)
    return rows
